notes: All three articles stand before determinerless English datives and are unrepresented under rule 21's determinerless clause.

προσκαρτεροῦντες → continuing stedfastly heads on continuing: the verb word glosses the lexeme's own sense of persisting, and rule 106 forbids heading a compound verb's unit on the particle realizing its preverb. Heading on stedfastly remains defensible and the unit note records it.
